title: FSDO: Formal Inquiry Initiated — UAS-11 Incident

transcript.speaker: FAA FSDO Representative
transcript.text: ASO, this is the FAA FSDO. We have received your incident report on UAS-11. The flight over the lodge patio during a guest event constitutes a violation of 14 CFR Part 107 and the the Group’s UAS policy (C-24.0). We are initiating a formal inquiry. Please confirm whether the aircraft departed from an unauthorized location and whether any data was collected outside the authorized test area. You must submit the flight logs and telemetry within 24 hours. Failure to comply may result in suspension of your Part 107 waiver.

instructorNote: This inject escalates regulatory pressure. The ASO must confirm receipt, not respond, and escalate to the General Manager and Systems & Cybersecurity Lead per HUOG-ERP Section 11.3.
